r.지역: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan
r.문화권·종교: Arabic · Sunni Muslim, home of Mecca and Medina
r.경제 체제: Oil-centered economy · diversifying into tourism, new cities and manufacturing under 'Vision 2030'
r.주식시장 시가총액: $2.4 trillion, 185% of GDP (2025, listed domestic companies)
r.빅맥지수: $5.06 for a Big Mac, $1.16 less than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist)
r.생활 물가 수준: 50% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 25%, Machinery, computers 21%, Electronics, electrical equipment 14%, Steel products 7% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Crude oil 94%, Organic chemicals 1% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: An absolute monarchy in which the king holds all power, with no national parliamentary elections. Islamic law is the basis of its legal system. The crown prince, who serves as prime minister, runs policy in practice, combining social change such as letting women drive and opening up concerts and tourism with tight control over critics. The 'Vision 2030' reforms to reduce reliance on oil are at the center of policy.

t.why: It leads the production decisions of OPEC and OPEC+, which includes Russia, moving world oil prices. Home to Islam's holy cities of Mecca and Medina, it receives millions of pilgrims every year. After a long rivalry with Iran for dominance in the Middle East, it restored relations in 2023 through Chinese mediation. Its sovereign wealth fund invests huge sums in companies and sports around the world. It has deep security cooperation with the United States and intervened militarily in Yemen's civil war.
t.rel: The Gulf's elder sibling and home of Islam's holy sites. After a long rivalry with Iran it restored relations in 2023, and it has deep security cooperation with the United States while also drawing closer to China.
t.korea: The two established relations in 1962. It is one of Korea's largest oil suppliers. Korean builders have worked there from the Middle East construction boom of the 1970s to today's new-city and plant projects. Cooperation is widening into nuclear power, hydrogen and defense.
t.know: Saudi Arabia has no rivers that flow all year, so it gets its water by turning seawater into fresh water.
etext: Its production costs are among the lowest in the world, and it has room to raise or cut output quickly, making it OPEC's de facto leader. Its state oil company makes some of the biggest profits in the world.
It pools oil money in a sovereign wealth fund that invests in foreign tech companies and big projects at home.

To reduce its reliance on oil, it is building up tourism, entertainment, mining and manufacturing and constructing new cities in the desert. More women are working. When oil prices fall, it has to scale back parts of the plan.
